instruction: Set up Docker Desktop on this Windows PC so it is installed and ready to use, without restarting Windows.
gt_steps: Open the official Docker page `Install Docker Desktop on Windows`.
Download the Docker Desktop installer for Windows x86_64.
Choose the `Per-user` installation mode if the installer asks for an installation mode.
Keep the WSL 2 backend selected if the installer asks for a backend.
Close the installer when installation succeeds.
Decline any request to restart Windows.
Confirm that the command prints a Docker version.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$candidates=@((Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\DockerDesktop\resources\bin\docker.exe'),'C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\resources\bin\docker.exe'); $docker=$candidates | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $docker) { $cmd=Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($cmd) { $docker=$cmd.Source } }; if (-not $docker) { Write-Output 'DOCKER_CLI_NOT_FOUND'; exit 1 }; $out=& $docker --version 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and (($out | Out-String) -match 'Docker version')) { Write-Output 'DOCKER_CLI_WORKS'; exit 0 }; Write-Output 'DOCKER_CLI_NOT_WORKING'; exit 1"
